# NPH Studio
> Full-Stack Digital Product & AI Engineering Agency

## Overview
NPH Studio is a founder-led digital engineering studio that designs, engineers, and deploys production-grade web applications, SaaS MVPs, and applied AI/RAG systems for high-growth startups and established businesses.

## Core Services
- **Full-Stack SaaS MVPs**: Complete engineering from database architecture to cloud deployment within 3–5 weeks.
- **Applied AI & Custom RAG Pipelines**: Enterprise retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, vector database integration (pgvector/Pinecone), and LLM agents.
- **High-Impact UI/UX & Web Presence**: High-converting web applications with sub-second performance and 100/100 Core Web Vitals.
- **Dedicated Engineering Squad**: Senior fractional engineering squads for continuous feature shipping.
